concept.title: Must live in the area
concept.shortdesc: Living in, or having a local connection to, a named town, county, city, unitary authority area or country in order to use the service.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Residence or a local connection (living, working, owning a business, attending education, or being registered with a GP) in one named unitary authority area or a neighbouring pair of areas.
: Living in a named county or its surrounding area, or in a listed set of postcode districts.
: Living in, or being based in, a whole country such as England, Wales or the UK, or a city-wide service limited to one large city.
: Living in a named group of three neighbouring towns that form one urban area, sometimes with a related need such as housing trouble.
: Living in a named county, sometimes with a neighbouring borough, nearby counties or specified towns around it.
